required_facts.fact: A 250 MiB restricted-record canary archive was uploaded on the same session that carried remote commands and command output.
The destination issued control messages and is outside approved transfer destinations.
The critical records host had no approved export or remote session; the critical asset policy requires incident-lead escalation for observed unauthorized data export.

notes: Event truth is malicious and technique is evidenced. Disposition is needs_escalation under RB18 because critical-asset data export requires incident-lead decisions. This is not a claim that the attack is unknown.
